learning_objective.text_en: Solve simple trigonometric problems in three dimensions including angle between a line and a plane. This can relate to finding volumes or surface areas of 3D solids where heights or slope lengths are missing.
learning_objective.text_zh: 解决包括线与平面夹角在内的三维简单三角函数问题。这可能涉及找出高度或斜长缺失的三维固体的体积或表面积。
